tei:div.tei:p: 87) ༄༅/ gnam chos thugs kyi gter kha snyan brgyud zab mo'i rtsa gsum spyi'i gtor ma'i las rim gnam lcags thog mda' bzhugs so// 88)༄༅/

na mo gu ru bhyaḥ mchog tu mi 'gyur bde chen rdo rje'i bdag /phrin las chags thogs med pa'i ye shes gar// kun bzang lha yi lha mchog bla ma rje// lhan skyes shes rab klong du gyur pas 'dud// gzung 'dzin las byung dgra dang bgegs// gnyis med rtogs pa'i mtshon chen gyis// bsad nas ye shes dbyings sbyor ba'i// dmar chen gtor ma'i las rim bshad// de la yo byad bsham tshul dang*/ cho ga dngos so/ dang po ni/ yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su dkyil 'khor gyi gzhir zhing lpags la khrag gis sbags pa'i 'bru tshom 89) lha grangs bkod pa'i dbus su mañdzi'i khar lcags snod du 'bru nag gi ngar phye dug khrag gis sbrus pa'i gtor ma gru gsum rno dbal can 'khor lha grangs kyis bskor ba mtshe yungs rtsang dang khram byang sogs drag rgyan rngam brjid dang ldan pa'i rtser sku rten lha mdog dang mthun pa'i dar gdugs sogs kyis brgyan/ mthar zor rdzas rnams dang*/ drag po'i mchod pa g.yas su bskor/ de rgyab stegs mtho bar rtsa gsum chos skyong gi gtor ma rnams dang*/ de mdun sman raka gtor gsum grangs tshang mchod pa dang bcas pa dang*/ mdun ngos su brub khung 90) liṅga can dang thun rdzas sogs nyer mkho'i yo byad rnams tshogs par bsham mo/ gnyis pa la/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes chog ste gsum las/ dang po la/ brgyud 'debs skyabs sems sngon gtor btang*// bgegs bskrad srung 'khor skyabs sems bzung*// byin dbab mchod rlab rgyun bshags so/ zhes pa ltar dgu las/ dang po ni/ tshig bdun gsol 'debs sngon du song bas/ e ma ho: nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams su: bcom ldan chos sku snang ba mtha' yas dang: tshe bdag rigs lnga'i sku la gsol ba 'debs: tshe yi rig 'dzin thob par byin gyis rlobs: lho phyogs po ta la yi gnas mchog na: longs sku rgyal ba rgya mtsho spyan ras gzigs: thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs la gsol ba 'debs:

'khor ba dong sprugs nus par byin gyis rlobs: lho nub rnga yab gling gi gzhal yas na: sku lnga mtshan brgyad gu ru drag po dang: rje 'bangs 91)nyi shu lnga la gsol ba 'debs: bskyed rdzogs brtan pa myur thob byin gyis rlobs: gdul bya 'gro 'dul zhing khams yangs pa na: gter ston brgya rtsa chos bdag las can sogs: rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs: sgrub pa mtha' ru phyin par byin gyis rlobs: yi dam zhi khro ma sring mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: bka' srung dam can kun la gsol ba 'debs: phrin las rnamabazhi lhun gyis grub pa dang: mchog thun dngos grub myur thob byin gyis rlobasaḥ tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub par mdzad du gsol: zhes sogs ji ltar rigs pas gsol ba gdab po/ gnyis pa tshogs gsog pa'i rim pa ni/ tshogs zhing mkha' khyab tu sad par bsam pa'i spyan sngar/ na mo: dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum: skyabs gnas rnams la skyabs su mchi: 'gro kun sangs rgyas la 92)'god phyir: byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do: lan gsum dang*/ 'gro kun bde ldan sdug bsngal bral: bde las nyams med btang snyoms shog: hūm̐: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs rnams: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: padma nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs: lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas la: dkar gsum mngar gsum bdud rtsis mchod: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas la: sdig sgrib nyams chag thams cad bshags: dge bsod kun la rjes yi rang: chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar 'tshal: mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs: 'gro ba sems can ma lus kun: kun tu bzang po'i sa thob shog: ces brjod la tshogs zhing rang la bsdu/ gsum pa ni/ rang nyid gnyug ma'i lhar gsal bas/ rin chen snod du gtor ma ni: bdud rtsir gyur 93)cig oṃ āḥhūm̐: gnyug gnas glo bur lhags pa yi: gnas bdag gzhi bdag 'byung po'i tshogs:

'dir 'dus mchod sbyin gtor ma bzhes: gnas 'dir gsang sngags sgrub pa la: ru nga phrag dog ma byed par: dkar phyogs stong grogs mthun rkyen sgrubs: nag phyogs bgegs rigs gzhan du dengs: gal te mi nyan 'tshe byed na: ye shes khro bos brlag par 'gyur: de bas bsgo ba'i bka' la nyon: oṃ sarba lo ka pā la bha liṃ ta khā hi khā hi: sarba bighnān gatstsha: ces brjod la gtor ma gshegs/ bzhi pa ni/ lha'i nga rgyal bstan pos/ hūm̐: nga ni khro bo dbang chen te: bgegs dang log 'dren nga la nyon: nga yi bka' las 'da' ma byed: nga yi bka' las 'da' byed na: bdag nyid nga rgyal thugs khros te: thal ba'i rdul du brlag par byed: de bas 94)da lta phyir dengs shig: oṃ sum bha ni sogs drag sngags tsham rngams dang bcas pas bgegs bskrad/ lnga pa ni/ rdo rje'i srung 'khor gsal zhing*/ hūm̐: nga ni che ge ste: thugs kar gser gyi ga'u'i nang: bdag cag dpon slob bsrung bya tshud: steng 'og rdo rje'i gur sar gyur: oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐: zhes pas mtshams bcad/ drug pa ni/ dam tshig la srung sems brtan pos/ hūm̐: ma 'grub bar du dkyil 'khor mi gtong na: yi dam che ge'i lha tshogs ma lus rnams: srog la bab kyang bdag gis bzung bar bgyi: bdag gi dam tshig gtong bar mi bgyid do: zhes pas dam bca'/ bdun pa ni/ ye shes pa'i gzi byin dbab cing*/ hūm̐: che ge'i lha tshogs ma lus rnams: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byin chen dbab tu gsol: skal ldan dad ldan bdag la dbang mchog bskur: log 'dren tshe yi bar chad bsal du gsol: oṃ badzra 95)a we sha ya āḥ zhes pas bdag gnas yo byad rnams la bstim/ brgyad pa ni/ mchod rdzas rnams/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces pas bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ ka dag klong nas sprul pa yi: gnam sa gang ba'i mchod pa'i sprin: sman gtor rakta lha mor bcas: zad med gyur cig pū dza hoḥ oṃ āḥm hā pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭha:

oṃ āḥm hā ba liṃ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭha: oṃ āḥm hā rakta hūm̐ hrīḥṭha: oṃ āḥbadzra puṣpe dhu pe ā lo ke ghandhe nai widya shabda āḥhūm̐: zhes pas mkha' khyab tu spel/ dgu pa ni/ nyes pa la 'gyod sdom drag pos/ hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dam can dang: chos skyong nor lha kun gyi thugs dang ni: 'gal bar gyur pa ma lus ci mchis pa: bdag gis gnong zhing 'gyod pas mthol lo bshags: badzra sa ma ya shuddhe āḥ 96) zhes pas rang rgyud dag par bya'o/ gnyis pa la rnal 'byor sgrub pa dang*/ las sbyor gnyis las/ dang po la/ rten bskyed spyan 'dren bzhugs su gsol// phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul bstod cing bshags// 'dzab bzlas stong tshig tshogs mchod do/ zhes pa ltar bcu las/ dang po la bdun las/ de bzhin nyid kyi ting 'dzin ni/ hūm̐: chos rnams thams cad rang gi sems las byung: sems nyid ye nas stong pa nyid kyi ngang: kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ sems can kun gyi de don ma rtogs pas: 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i sems can snying re rje: rgyu yi ting nge 'dzin ni/ chos rnams thams cad rten 'brel rgyu las byung: hūm̐ ni rgyu yi sa bon nyid du gsal: des bsregs gtor bkrus te 'byung rim gsal ba ni/ de las ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gsum 'phros pa yis: ram̐ gyi mes bsregs yam̐ gyi rlung gis gtor: kham̐ gi chus bkrus stong pa nyid du gdal: e yam̐ kham̐ sum̐ bhrūm̐ gyi yi ge yis: rang byung 'byung ba 97) chen po lnga chags te: mkha' rlung chu dang ri rab gser gyi gzhi: rten gzhal yas khang bskyed pa ni/ de steng bhrūm̐ gyi yi ge las bskyed pa'i: gzhal yas khang ni sgo gru rta babs rdzogs: gdugs tog chos 'khor ri dwags pad 'dab mtshan: rdo rwa ye shes lnga yi me ri 'bar: bhrūm̐ bi shwa bhi shuddhe e dzñā na tsakra maṇḍal bhrūm̐: brten pa lha bskyed pa ni/ rang gi mos pa dang bstun par rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gang yin pa'i bdag mdun dus gcig tu lha bskyed pa grub nas/

gnas gsum byin gyis brlab pa ni/ gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan: thugs ka'i sa bon sngags 'khor las: 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros: ye shes lha tshogs spyan drangs bstim: gnyis pa ni/ dad pa mos pa rtse gcig pas/ hūm̐: sku gsum rtsa brgyud bla ma spyan 'dren no: yi dam lha tshogs ma lus spyan 'dren no: mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kun 98)ma lus spyan 'dren no: chos skyong nor lha grogs mdzad spyan 'dren no: badzra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs/ gsum pa ni/ dam ye ro gcig par mos pas/ hūm̐: sna tshogs padma zla ba'i gdan steng du: rtsa brgyud bla ma ma lus bzhugs su gsol: nyi zla padma brjid pa'i gdan steng du: yi dam lha tshogs thams cad bzhugs su gsol: sna tshogs rin chen padma'i gdan steng du: mkha' 'gro thams cad dgyes par bzhugs su gsol: padma nyi ma bam ro'i gdan steng du: chos skyong srung ma thams cad bzhugs su gsol: badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: zhes pas bstim/ bzhi pa ni/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas tha mal pa'i lus su spros pa dang sems can thams cad lhan gcig pas/ hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro thams cad dang: chos skyong nor lha dam can rgya mtsho la: bdag gis rab tu gus pas dwangs ba yis: lus ngag yid gsum dad pas phyag 'tshal lo: a ti pu ho: 99) zhes phyag 'tshal/ lnga pa ni/ mchod pa'i lha mo mang po sprul pas/ hūm̐ḥ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong dang: nor lha dam can gter bdag thams cad la: mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog bdug spos dang: mar me dri chab zhal zas rol mo 'bul: gzugs mdzes sgra snyan dri zhim ro mngar dang: reg bya 'jam pa bdag gis mchod pa 'bul: ye shes lnga yi bdud rtsi chen po dang: ba liṃ gtor ma'i zhal zas brjid pa dang: khams gsum bsgral ba'i rakta mchod pa 'bul: sku gsung thugs kyi rig ma dkar dmar mthing: shin tu mdzes pa lta na sdug pa la: rin chen dar zab mang po'i rgyan gyis brgyan:

rtsa ba gsum la bdag gis mchod pa 'bul: log 'dren dgra bgegs bstan la gnod byed rnams: chos kyi dbyings su bdag gis bsgral 100)byas te: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul: arghaṃ padyaṃ puṣpe dhupe āloke gandhe nai widya shabda pū dza shapda gandhe ra sa sparshe a mṛ ta ba liṃ ta rakta mu dre ma traṃ ru tra pra be sha ya kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes mchod do/ drug pa ni/ yon tan rgya cher dran pas/ hūm̐: dad ldan bu la byin rlabs char 'bebs pa'i: bla ma'i lha tshogs kun la bstod par bgyi: dngos grub ma lus lhun gyis grub mdzad pa'i: yi dam kun la bdag gis bstod par bgyi: 'gro ba snang srid dbang du sdud mdzad pa'i: mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bdag gis bstod par bgyi: bstan pa srung ba'i las la rab tu brtson: chos skyong kun la bdag gis bstod par bgyi: dgos 'dod re ba skong bar mdzad pa yi: nor lha'i tshogs la bdag gis bstod par bgyi: bstan la gnod byed bsgral bar 101)mdzad pa yi: dam can tshogs la bdag gis bstod par bgyi: zhes bstod/ bdun pa ni/ nyes ltung la gso sbyong gi 'dun pas/ hūm̐: bla ma rnams la 'byor tshogs chung ba bshags: yi dam lha la spong len byas pa bshags: mkha' 'gro rnams la gsang ba bsgrags pa bshags: chos skyong rnams la mchod gtor chung ba bshags: tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub la stsal du gsol: zhes dang*/ yig brgya brjod pas bshags so/ brgyad pa la bzhi'i dang po/ dam ye so sor bskyed pa'i/ thugs ka'i sa bon sngags kyis bskor ba las: 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas rgyal ba mchod: sems can rnams kyi sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs: rgyal ba'i byin rlabs 'khor 'das mthu stobs rnams: bsdus nas rang la thim pas mthu stobs rgyas: zhes pa'i dmigs gnad dang bcas gzhung gang 102) la brten pa'i bsnyen sgrub sngags rnams ci mang bzlas rjes/ gnyis pa la srung ba'i dmigs bzlas ni/

rang gi phyag gnyis nyi zla'i ga'u ni: kha sbyor bsnams pa'i nang du bsrung bya rnams: tshud pas bskal pa'i rlung yang mi thar zhing: gnod byed gang gis mi tshugs bsrung bar gyur: rtsa sngags gsham du/ e sa bhyo srung: zhes bzla/ gsum pa bzlog dmigs ni/ rang nyid phyag gnyis nyi zla'i cha lang bsnams: brdab pas gnod byed byad ma lha srung bcas: sha khrag dmar chal rdul du brlag par gyur: rtsa sngags mthar/ e sa bhyo bzlog: ces btags pa ci nus bzlas mthar/ na mo/ rin 'dzin rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags dang rigs sngags dang gzungs sngags dang snying po dang phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin gyi bden 103)pa dang*/ chos nyid gdod nas stong kyang chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang*/ khyad par du khrag 'thung khro bo'i rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs bka' sdod pho nya'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i mthu la brten nas rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi sngon gyi las dang 'phral gyi rkyen ngan pa thams cad dang*/ khyad par ban bon sngags kyi mthu byad rbad 'dre rbod gtong than dang ltas ngan mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad mā ra ya rbad zlog ces brjod la thal mo lan gsum brdab bo/ bzhi pa thun rdzas sgrub pa ni/ thun snod nad mtshon dug rlangs khol ba'i klong: thun rdzas las byed pho nya za byed rngams: gtum drag rgyob sod 'jigs pa'i 'brug stong 'dir: stong khams gang ba'i thog rgod chem chem 'khrugs: log 'dren gnad la dbab pa'i mthu ldan 104)gyur: rtsa sngags sham du/ gnod byed dgra bgegs kyi srog rtsa la yaṃ yaṃ: snying rtsa la rbad rbad: srog la hur thuṃ: nri tri e hur thuṃ dza: mā ra ya rbad rbad:

ces btags pa bzlas la kha rlangs ma shor bar lag ngar brgyud nas phus 'debs/ dgu pa ni/ dbyangs gsal/ yig brgya/ rten snying bcas lan gsum gsum bzlas pa'i mthar/ hūm̐: ye shes lha tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bstod: nyams chags 'gal 'khrul ci mchis bshags: ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta bha liṃ ta rakta khā hiḥ zhes dang dge ba bsngo'o/ phrin las kyi rgyab dpung bcol ba'i ched du bka' gter srung ma spyi dang bye brag la gtor ma 'bul zin nas/ bcu pa la gsum/ dang po tshogs byin gyis brlab pa ni/ bā la dang ma dā na sogs tshogs kyi yo byad la chu chang nang mchod kyis sbran la/ hūm̐: rang nyid lha yi thugs ka nas: raṃ las me byung dngos 'dzin bsregs: 105)yam̐ las rlung byung bag chags gtor: kham̐ las chu byung gnyis 'dzin bkrus: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum 'od du zhu: bdud rtsi dkar dmar mthing gar gyur: ces 'dod yon lnga'i sprin phung 'phro ba nam mkha' gang bar bsgyur la/ gnyis pa 'bul ba ni/ tshogs phud rim pa gsum du spros pa cha bzhi bzhir spros pa rtsa gsum srung ma dang bcas pa'i gtor ma'i tshig dang bstun par tshogs chang dang bcas bran cing*/

hūm̐: sku gsum rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: yi dam lha tshogs ma lus pa: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs thams cad kun: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: chos skyong srung ma ma lus pa: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: nor lha dam can rgya mtsho rnams: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: tshogs gtor 'di la 106)byin gyis rlobs: rnal 'byor bsam pa bsgrub tu gsol: rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: dgyes pa'i tshul gyis bzhes su gsol: bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub stsol: thugs dang 'gal bar gyur pa bshags: dam sri gnod byed zhal du bstabs: gu ru dāe ba dhā ki ni ga na tsakra pū dza kha hī: zhes pas mchod/ gsum pa thugs dam bskang ba ni/ skang rdzas rnams kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin lta bur gyur: oṃ badzra spha ra ṇa khaṃ: zhes pas byin gyis brlabs nas/ bskang ba dngos ni/ hūm̐: bcom ldan kun bzang yab yum dang: snang ba mtha' yas la sogs pa'i: chos sku'i sangs rgyas thams cad la: bkra shis rdzas rtags rin chen bdun: bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yi: mchod pa 'bul lo thugs dam bskang: hūm̐: bcom ldan rgyal ba brgya mtsho dang: phyag stong spyan 107)stong la sogs pa: longs spyod rdzogs sku'i lha rnams la: bkra shis rdzas rtags rin chen bdun: bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yi: mchod pa 'bul lo thugs dam bskang: hūm̐: bcom ldan sprul sku padma 'byung: sku gsum sku lnga mtshan brgyad dang: rig 'dzin grub thob thams cad la: bkra shis rdzas rtags rin chen bdun: bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yi: mchod pa 'bul lo thugs dam bskang: hūm̐: bcom ldan gu ru drag po rtsal: bka' dgongs phur gsum la sogs pa: yi dam lha tshogs thams cad la: bkra shis rdzas rtags rin chen bdun: bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yi: mchod pa 'bul lo thugs dam bskang:

hūm̐: bcom ldan rdo rje phag mo dang: lo ma gyon ma la sogs pa: ye shes mkha' 'gro thams cad la: bkra shis rdzas rtags rin chen bdun: bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yi: mchod 108)pa 'bul lo thugs dam bskang: hūm̐: ma ning phyag bzhi dud sol ma: rang byung rgyal mo la sogs pa: ma mgon lcam dral thams cad la: bkra shis rdzas rtags rin chen bdun: bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yi: mchod pa 'bul lo thugs dam bskang: hūm̐: bcom ldan dzam la rigs dgu dang: rnam sras nor lha thams cad la: bkra shis rdzas rtags rin chen bdun: bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yi: mchod pa 'bul lo thugs dam bskang: hūm̐: ma gza' dam gsum shan pa dang: bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho la: bkra shis rdzas rtags rin chen bdun: bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yi: mchod pa 'bul lo thugs dam bskang: hūm̐: bcom ldan rtsa ba gsum po la: 'khor ba'i ma rig 'khrul pa yis: ma shes thugs dang 'gal gyur te: mthol lo bshags so sa ma ya: oṃ sa ma ya: āḥs ma ya: hūm̐ sa 109)ma ya: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥbadzra gu ru dāe wa dhā ki ni sarba dharma pā la sarba ba su de wa sarba lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badzra satwa sa ma ya sogs yi ge brgya pa brjod/ gnyis pa las sbyor la/ bsad las kyi sbyor ba dang*/ bzlog pa'i las sbyor gnyis las/ dang po la dngos dang rjes 'brel lo/ dang po la/ bskul dang brngan 'bul gzu dpang gsol// dmigs bya bskyed dang rnam shes 'gugs /'gyed dang dbye dang gnad la dbab/ ces pa ltar brgyad las/ dpung bsdu phyir thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: rang bzhin rnam dag chos dbyings drag po'i zhing: skye med dbyings las sgyu ma'i skur bzhengs pa: khrag 'thung khro rgyal gtso 'khor sprul par bcas: mngon spyod phrin las mdzad phyir thugs dam bskul: khyed thugs chos dbyings zhi las ma g.yos kyang: snyigs ma lnga bdo'i las ngan 'gro ba rnams: zhi bas mi thul de phyir

110)thugs rje ches: mi bzod rab 'jigs drag po'i skur bzhengs shig: byang chub sgrub la 'tshe ba'i gdon bgegs dang: zhing bcu tshang ba bstan pa spyi yi dgra: khyad par bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo'i tshogs: mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las ma g.yel bar: rings par khug la srog chod dus mtha' stungs: ming tsam med par rdul du brlag pa yi: thugs dam dus la bab bo sa ma ya: rnal 'byor bdag gi dad pas bskul bsgrub tshe: 'dod pa'i 'bras bu mchis par mi mdzad na: zhal bzhes thugs dam nyams par mi 'gyur ram: de bas khrag 'thung 'khor bcas dbyings nas bzhengs: mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ces gdung ba'i shugs drag pos thugs dam bskul bar bya'o/ gnyis pa ni/ gser skyems la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: gser skyems zag pa med pa 111)bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ sa byin gyis brlabs la/ hūm̐: byin rlabs mchog stsol rtsa brgyud bla ma dang: yi dam zhi khro sgrub pa bka' brgyad lha: sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro la: gser skyems mchod pa 'bul lo phrin las mdzod: mthu stobs dbang phyug dpal mgon lcam dral dang: dregs pa'i sde dpon chen po sum cu sogs: ye shes las las grub pa'i dam can la: gser skyems mchod pa 'bul lo phrin las mdzod: phyi nang gsang ba gab sbas bstan pa skyong: dregs pa sde brgyad yul lha gzhi bdag sogs: srid gsum 'byung po mthu stobs can rnams la: gser skyems mchod pa 'bul lo phrin las mdzod: ces phul/ gsum pa ni/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: mi phyed dad pas zhugs pa'i rnal 'byor 112)bdag: sgrub pa snying por dam du bcas pa la: bar gcod 'tshe ba dam nyams dgra yis byas: da ni mngon spyod drag po'i las brtsam na: lha dang dam can rgya mtsho grogs la byon: bdag ni ma nyes dam nyams dgra yis nyes:

nyes byas 'di la chad pa'i las mdzod cig: nyes med rnal 'byor bdag gi grogs g.yel na: sngon gyi tha tshig 'gal bar gyur ta re: khas blangs snyan gyi mtha' la ma gtong bar: do nub gzu dpang gnyen po'i grogs la byon: khyed kyi drang po'i sems kyis da lta rang: sdig can dgra bo sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams kyang byin ma chung: chos skyong srung ma rnams kyang mthu ma chung: bka' srung las mkhan rnams kyang rtsal ma zhan: sngags 'chang rnal 'byor bdag gi bsam pa sgrubs: zhes gsol bas snod bcud lhar gsal ba thams cad 113) sngon gyi thugs dam las bzhengs te/ rang la gnang ba stsal zhing dgra bgegs la thugs cher 'khrugs pas drag po'i las la rngams zhing rings ba'i tshul gyis bzhugs par bsam/ bzhi pa ni/ mdun du e las gshin rje'i btson khang lcags mkhar gru gsum bang rim dgu pa nag la rngams pa dmar la 'jigs pa kha dog la mthil yangs pa: zin nas thar pa med pa: phyi na zhe sdang gi bskal pa'i me chen 'bar ba: nang du gti mug las kyi mun nag 'khrigs pa: 'og na 'dod chags khrag mtsho'i rba rlabs 'khrugs pa'i dbus su nṛ dang tri las dgra bgegs gnod byed mngon sum lta bu sngo la ham pa skem la rid pa mig shi mig tu 'dug pa: kha nas bdud pho nga long gi 'o dod 'bod pa: lag pa g.yas pas brang brdung zhing g.yon pas skra 'bal ba: rkang pa lcags su bcug pa nyam thag pa'i gzugs can 'dar phri li 114)li byed pa zhig tu gyur: ces gsal gdab po/ lnga pa ni/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcings te/ na mo/ rin 'dzin rtsa brgyud sogs bden stobs gong ltar gyi mthar/ bden pa chen po'i mthu la brten nas/ bdag cag dpon slob bsrung bya 'khor dang bcas pa la sdang bar byed pa'i dgra/ gnod par byed pa'i bgegs/ za bar byed pa'i 'dre/ phung bar byed pa'i sri/ bar du gcod pa'i rkyen/ mdor na gnod par byed cing bar du gcod pa gang yin pa thams cad skad cig nyid du liṅga 'di la khug cig

ces dang*/ rtsa sngags mthar/ dgra bgegs gnod byed dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ a we sha ya a āḥ zhes btags pa bdun nam gsum bya/ drug pa ni/ pho nya rab tu mang po spros te/ hūm̐: dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab: sprul pa 'gyed pa'i dus la bab: dgra bgegs 'gugs pa'i dus la bab: sdang ba'i dgra dang 115)gnod pa'i bgegs: gang la bya ba khyod kyis shes: bla srog rnam par shes pa kun: ma shor ma btang khug la shog: btab pa'i dus las ma 'da' bar: zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra dang bgegs: thams cad ma lus myur du khug: lcags kyu can gyis snying nas drongs: zhags pa can gyis yan lag chings: lcags sgrog can gyis dbang po sdoms: dril bu can gyis myos su chug: las kyi rlung gis rgyab nas phul: 'jigs pa'i mun pas mdun nas sus: skad cig de ni yud tsam la: rang dbang med par khug la shog: oṃ badzra aṅku sha dzaḥ ratna pa sha hūm̐: padma spho ṭa bam̐: karma ghaṇḍe hoḥ zhes drag tu rbad cing bskul lo/ bdun pa ni/ dbye rdzas kyis bdug cing sgro gnyis kyis phyir 'byed pas/ bhyo: phyag brnyan chen po'i dus la 116)bab: dngos grub 'phrog pa'i dgra dang bgegs: gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams: 'go ba'i lha dang bral bar gyis: bhyo: rlung lha'i bu mo drag rtsal can: dam nyams dgra bo las ngan 'di'i: dgra lha spyi bo'i gtsug nas phrol: srog lha snying gi dkyil nas phrol: zhang lha lte ba'i khung nas phrol: ma lha gsang ba'i gnas nas phrol: pho lha phrag pa g.yas nas phrol: yul lha lag pa g.yon nas phrol: ban bon la sogs 'go ba'i lha: rig 'dzin srung ma rgyab nas phrol: dam nyams lha dang phral bar gyis: ma ma trag ru tra mā ra ya phyes phyes: a nri trag raksha mā ra ya phyes phyes: zhes bsrung bya srung byed kha sbyar dbye'o/ brgyad pa gnad la dbab pa la lnga las/ dang po ni thun rdzas sna tshogs kyis brab cing*/ hūm̐: yungs kar thun dang yungs 117)nag thun:

ke tshe'i thun dang shang tshe'i thun: dug khrag thun la sogs pa yi: thun rdzas 'dus pa'i mtshon cha dang: drag sngags dmod pa'i ser chen gyis: dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlog: rtsa sngags gsham bur/ dgra bgegs mā ra ya phaṭaḥ ces brab/ gnyis pa phur gdab pa ni/ phur bu thal mo'i bar du bzung*/ rang gi sor mo bcu rigs lnga yab yum bcur gyur: sa ma ya hoḥ rjes su chags pa'i sbyor bas snyoms par zhugs pa'i mkha' las phur pa sras mchog tu gyur pa ni: sku stod srin po khros pa'i nyams can phyag gnyis phur bu 'dril ba lte ba man chad chu srin gyi kha nas gnam lcags 'bar ba'i dbal zur gsum shin tu rno ba'i khong gseng lha yi pho breng du bcas pa: rtse mor dregs pa'i dmag tshogs las la rngams shing dus me'i tshwa tshwa 'phro 118)bar gyur: oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya ka ya wākka tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsha maṃ: phur bu las byung ba'i 'od zer gyis rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs nus mthu 'od zer gyi rnam par spyan drangs: phur bu la thim pas khams gsum dus gcig tu sgrol ba'i mthu dang ldan par bsams la phur bu 'dril zhing 'debs pas/ hūm̐ḥ rdo rje phur pa kī la ya: stod ni khro chen rngams pa'i zhal: sku smad gnam lcags phur bu 'dril: dgra bgegs srog la kī la ya: pho rgyud rtsad nas chod la shog: lte ba'i dkyil du kī la ya: mo rgyud mngal nas skem la shog: snying gi gsang la kī la ya: rdul phran bzhin du brlag par gyis: rtsa sngags dang*/ gnod byed dgra bgegs kyi srog la kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa: ces phur bu snying dkar nag mtshams su 'dril zhing btab la/ phaṭaḥ ces brjod de 119) rnam shes dang ye shes lus dang srog rnams kha sbyor dbye ba'i man ngag tshe khrus kyi dgongs pa dang ldan par bsgral ba ni thugs rje rjes 'dzin gyi phur bus brten pa dbyings su bsgral ba'o/ gdab phur spyi mgrin snying lte gsang gnas lnga dang*/

mig rna sna lce/ don snod drug yan lag lnga/ sha rus pags pa rtsa rgyus rnams dang*/ mdza' bshes gnyen 'khor yul mkhar dbang thang longs spyod sogs la btab pas las phur gyis rten gzhi bsgral lo/ gsum pa sgrol gris snyigs ma dum bur bsgral ba ni/ hūm̐: mtshon chen 'bar ba chen po yis: lus ni dum bur gtub par bya: phung po rtsad nas bcad par bya: rdul phran bzhin du brlag par bya: rtsa sngags gsham du/ gnod byed dgra bgegs mā ra ya phaṭaḥ ces dang gong gi thun rdzas sgrub pa'i sngags kyang bzla zhing gzir/ bzhi pa tho bas brdung ba ni/ hūm̐: rdungs shig rdo rje 'bar ba'i gtun: bka' las 'da' byed 120)sdig can rnams: mkha' 'gro 'bar ba'i gtun khung du: rdo rje tho bas brdungs byas pas: lha yang rung ste brlag byed na: dgra dang bgegs la smos ci dgos: oṃ padma a kro ta ya kha thaṃ kha thaṃ: zhes brdung*/ lnga pa zhal bstab ni/ ling ro'i cha shas tsam bzlog pa'i skabs 'bul rgyu dang lhag gtor la bsre rgyu bzhag gzhan rnams hom gzar sogs su khyer ba raktas bran la dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'dod yon gyi phung po zad mi shes par spel la/ hūm̐: stong gsum bhandha 'bar ba'i snod mchog tu: dgra bgegs dbang po sha khrag rus pa dang: don snying bla tshe rkang mar bcas pa rnams: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du bstab: rngams byed hom khung yangs pa'i mgul du bstim: 'khor 'das mnyam pa nyid du bzhes su gsol: dgra bgegs kyi ma hā maṃ sa la khā hiḥ rakta la khā hiḥ king ni ri ti la khā hiḥ go ro tsa na la khā hi: 121)ba su ta la khā hiḥ ma hā tsitta la khā hiḥ zhes gtor ma thams cad la bran no/ gnyis pa la gnyis/ tshogs la rol ba ni/ tha mal gyi rtog pa'i 'ching ba 'grol phyir las slob kyis/ hoḥ tshogs kyi mchod pa rgyan du rol: zhes thabs shes kyi rdzas drangs la/ a la la hoḥ zhes blangs nas rang lus dkyil 'khor nang gi sreg blugs kyi dga' bas mnyes shing tshim par bya/

gnyis pa lhag gtor ni/ lhag ma rnams bsdus la slob dpon gyis kha phru btab nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs te/ ma mo mkha' 'gro sha za dur bdag mo: lhag la dbang ba'i 'byung po gtor len rnams: lhag ma 'di bzhes gnod byed dgra dang bgegs: thams cad rdul du brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod: utstshiṣṭa ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hiḥ zhes phyi rol gyi 'byung po la sbyin no/ gnyis pa bzlog pa'i las sbyor la/ dngos dang*/ rgyun gyi rjes 122) chog go dang po la gzhi'i bdag po bzlog pa'i dpung du phrin las bskul ba ni/ ling ro khrag skyems dang sbyar ba zor gtor la rim par bran cing*/ hūm̐: chos sku zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang: gzugs sku 'jigs pa'i cha lugs rdzogs mdzad pa: rig 'dzin yi dam ḍā ki chos skyong tshogs: mi mngon dbyings nas gnas 'dir sku bskyod la: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril rkan sgra chems se chem: dgra bgegs sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol: pad 'byung zab ston rdo rje gro bo lod: seṅge sgra sgrogs dmar nag me phreng can: padma badzra dgongs 'dus lha yi tshogs: rdo rje drag rtsal me dbal lcags sdig sogs: rig 'dzin khros pa'i lha tshogs thams cad kyis: dgra bgegs sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol: drwa ba sdom pa'i lha tshogs 'khor 123)lo lnga: sku gsung thugs dang snying po kye rdo rje: ma ya thod pa rigs bsdus gur gyi lhaḥ gdan bzhi yab yum bdud rtsi rdo rje sogs: he ru ka yi lha tshogs thams cad kyis: dgra bgegs sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol: che mchog dpal dgu yab yum sras dang 'khor: yang dag thugs mchog 'bar ba lnga bcu brgyad: rdo rje gzhon nu khro bcu khra thabs bcas: ye shes 'jigs byed gsang bdag khyung gi tshogs:

yi dam dpal chen lha tshogs thams cad kyis: dgra bgegs sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol: dgra nag gdong drug 'jigs byed gshed dmar nag: tshe bdag 'chi bdag khro chu dug sdong can: king kang dmar nag 'char ka chos kyi rgyal: gnam lcags pha lam rdo rje zhun byed sogs: 'jam 124)dpal gshin rje gshed po'i lha tshogs rnams: dgra bgegs sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol: dbang chen dmar nag rta nag dregs pa'i tshogs: gsang ba ye shes phag khros seng gdong ma: 'jigs byed chen mo las hur drag mo'i tshogs: ri rab so gnyis rdul mnyam ḍā ki ma: gnas yul dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad kyis: dgra bgegs sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol: rgyud bdag drag po ro za gdams ngag rgyal: bgegs dgra dme ba brtsegs dang stobs po che: hūm̐ mdzad khams gsum rnam rgyal mi g.yo mgon: 'byung 'dul rnam par 'joms dang 'dod pa'i rgyal: ye shes khro bo'i lha tshogs thams cad kyis: dgra bgegs sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol: bya rog mtshan can sku lnga yab dang yum: 125)bya rog gdong dgu rtsa 'jib tsaṇṭi ka: nag po stong sde sha za 'bum gyi tshogs: ma mo bye ba gnod sbyin khri yi 'khor: dmag dpon brgyad dang khrab chen bye ba 'bum: dgra bgegs sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol: legs ldan bing dang tshogs bdag a gho ra: sras mchog nag po phyogs bcu'i mgon po sogs: dregs byed ber nag yab yum gtso brgyad dang: dregs pa'i gtso bo bdun cu rtsa gnyis rnams: dgra bgegs sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol: mgon po yid bzhin nor bu shing phur can:

kṣe ṭa pa la gnod sbyin mched sde bzhi: kṣe ṭa pa la sprel khrid bya gdong ma: dpal mgon bdun cu dregs pa stong phrag lnga: thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs ma lus rnams: 126)dgra bgegs sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol: ma ning sde lnga srog bdud dpal 'bar ma: thub bdag glog phreng spu gri gcig shur dang: ma mgon sde brgyad bdud dmag stong gi tshogs: zhang blon nag po yaksha dhā dza sogs: bdud dmag byed ba 'bum 'gyur tshogs bcas kyis: dgra bgegs sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol: rgyud gur nag po 'bar ba hūm̐ mdzad nag: gri gug khros pa srin mgon gdong bzhi pa: dur khrod bdag po yab yum dbang phyug che: seng gdong yab yum bam ro sde brgyad bcas: brag mgon mdung 'dzin la sogs mgon po rnams: dgra bgegs sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol: rang byung rgyal mo dud pa'i 127)sol ba ma: dmag zor rgyal mo re ti mched sde bzhi: e ka tsa ti srog sgrub kha mo che: spyang zhon mched gsum ḍā ki za byed gdong: lha mo'i rigs gyur stong dang rtsa brgyad kyis: dgra bgegs sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol: ba lam drel sna khri sman si li ma: stag sman ser ldem dpal lha rab brtan ma: a phyi mched lnga tshe ring mched sde lnga: kho le thang nag dpal mo drag mo mtsho: 'jig rten las kyi ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: dgra bgegs sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol: grags byed bse yi skyes bu mdung dmar can: shan pa dmar nag yab yum las byed brgyad: beg rtse yam shud gri thogs shan pa'i 'khor: gtsug na me 'bar rol pa rkya bdun sogs: 128)bstan srung gnod sbyin drag po thams cad kyis:

dgra bgegs sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol: mgar ba dmar nag mched 'khor dpung dang bcas: dregs pa sum sbrel dregs pa lnga 'dus dang: 'bar ba spun bdun jag me sprag gi btsan: lung btsan ldang lha drag po snying drung btsan: zhang blon btsan rgod 'khor dang bcas pa yis: dgra bgegs sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol: khyab 'jug drag po gza' brgyad gdong mo bzhi: hab sha rda ra nag po ngan ne ma: gzhon nu gtum po bsnyo kha rdo rje rgyal: thang lha ha sa garbha ti pa tsa: bka' srung gza' klu sa bdag tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol: 129)spu gri mched gsum mkha' ri lcam dral gnyis: bdud po rdo 'bar dgu thub a tsa ra: tshogs bdag drag po tsa du mched sde dgu: tshe ring ro langs kha nas me 'bar dang: rdo rje mon pa la sogs srung ma rnams: dgra bgegs sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol: lce spyang ma brgyad dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad: gri thogs khram thogs shwa thogs shan pa'i tshogs: khyi brgyad spyang brgyad 'brug gsum dmus long brgyad: phur srung bcu drug ging lang pho mo sogs: bka' brgyad pho nya bka' srung yongs rdzogs rnams: dgra bgegs sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol: phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang sde brgyad sogs: dregs chen bco brgyad dregs pa nyi shu gcig: sde dpon sum cu sde 'khor dpung dang bcas: rdo rje 130)de mo brtan skyong ya ma'i tshogs: dge bsnyen nyer gcig dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs: dgra bgegs sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol:

zhes brjod/ gnyis pa 'gal rkyen dmigs kyis bzlog pa ni/ bhyo: mdos zor sha khrag gtor ma 'dis: da lta rnal 'byor bdag cag la: sde brgyad chad pa 'byung ba zlog: byad zor phur kha thams cad zlog: bandhe'i sngags zor 'dus pa zlog: mu stegs bon po'i dzo dmar zlog: lha 'dre'i za kha zug pa zlog: rgyal po lo yi bdun zur zlog: blon po zla ba'i dbang btsan zlog: dmag mi zhag gi dpung dgra zlog: mtshon cha dus kyi rno ngar zlog: spar kha'i skya mda' zug pa zlog: sme ba dur du chud pa zlog: sa bdag ko long dam pa zlog: 'byung ba'i dgra bshed 'thab pa zlog: gza' skar dus tshes ngan pa zlog: lo zla zhag dus bab pa zlog: 131)khram dang byad du bcug pa zlog: hom dang spar bu bskor ba zlog: dgra chag bdud du langs pa zlog: ltas ngan glo bur ye 'drog zlog: dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad zlog: mi kha bra mchu thams cad zlog: chags che nyam nga thams cad zlog: sngun bsgug phyis nas 'ded pa zlog: dgra sna phung sna gyod sna zlog: nad sna rims sna yams sna zlog: dgra sri rmi lam thams cad zlog: che sri chung sri rgan sri zlog: gzhon sri dar sri god sri zlog: dgra sri mtshon sri nad sri zlog: mdor na srid pa'i chag sgo dang: bdag la gnod pa'i dgra 'dre rnams: sdang bar byed pa'i steng du zlog: gnod byed bgegs kyi steng du bhyo: bar chad bdud kyi steng du bhyo: dgra 'dre phung sri'i steng du zor: dam nyams byad ma'i steng du bhyo: zhes pa'i zlog 'phyang grangs ci nus bskyar/ gsum pa zlog sngags bzla ba ni/ rtsa sngags sham du/ 132) e sa bhyo zlog: zhes btags pa brgya 'am nyer gcig bzlas mthar bden stobs thal rdeb bcas bya'o/ bzhi pa thun gtor ni/ dmar gyi gtor mar rakta bran la dmigs bya dgug pa ni/ na mo/ rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud sogs kyi bden stobs dang*/ bdag cag dpon slob

sogs kyi mthar/ gang yin pa thams cad sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di la khug cig: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes pas bkug bdud rtsi bran la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: a las thod pa'i snod du gtor ma ni: ngo bo ye shes bdud rtsi chen po la: rnam pa dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus: lha tshogs dgyes bskang 'dod yon sprin du gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: zhes lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ rtsa sngags dang*/ sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hiḥ zhes lan gsum gyis 'phul ba'i lhag ma nad mtshon dug gi rang bzhin can du dmigs la zor du 'phang ba ni/ hūm̐: drag po zor gyi dpung 133)tshogs dgra la bhyo: sdang dgra gdon bgegs thal ba'i rdul du rlog: sdang ba'i dgra bo yid la brnag pa 'di'i: mi sod khyim shig nor phyugs thal bar rlog: dgra bgegs rtsad nas gcod pa'i phrin las mdzod: bhyo bhyo sdang ba'i dgra la bhyo: bhyo bhyo gnod pa'i bgegs la bhyo: bhyo bhyo za ba'i 'dre la bhyo: bhyo bhyo phung ba'i sri la bhyo: zor zor dmigs pa'i yul du zor: zhes dang zlog sngags bcas dgra phyogs su dang 'phang ngo*/ gnyis pa la/ chad tho brtan ma rta bro brdung*// mchod bstod nongs bshags rten bzhugs dang*// bsdu ldang bsngo smon shis pa brjod/ ces pa ltar bcu gcig las/ dang po la/ chos skyong gi 'bul gtor la dmigs bya dgug cing stob pa sngon du song bas/ chad tho bsgrags pa ni/ hūm̐: sngon tshe slob dpon padma yis: lha srin dam la btags pa rnams: sngon gyi dam bca' ma g.yel bar: rgyan gyi gtor ma 134)'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod: ces dang*/ gnyis pa ni/ hūm̐: slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyis: brtan ma bcu gnyis dam la btags: bka' dam dam las ma 'da' bar: rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bcol pa'i phrin las myur du mdzod: ma ma hring hring ba liṃ ta khā hi khā hiḥ zhes gtor ma gnyis me sgron bshal chu dang bcas te phyir dor/

gsum pa ni/ gtor gzhong sbubs pa'i steng rdo rjes rgyas gtab ste/ hūm̐: stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na: zhing bcu bsgral ba'i gdan steng du: dpal chen lha tshogs bro brdungs pas: dgra ni thal bar brlag pa'i bro: bgegs ni phye mar 'thag pa'i bro: gnyis 'dzin ru tra sgrol ba'i bro: bar chad med par brdung bar bya: oṃ laṃ: āḥlaṃ: hūm̐ laṃ: st+waṃ bha ya nan: zhes khro bo'i stangs stabs kyis bro bya'o/ bzhi pa rjes 135) chog mchod pa ni/ hrīḥ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la: lha rdzas phyi yi mchod pa 'bul: rang byung nang gi mchod pa 'bul: gnyis med gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: sman gtor rakta'i mchod pa 'bul: sbyor sgrol ting 'dzin mchod pa 'bul: badzra arghaṃ sogs nas/ shabda pra tītstsha swa hā: ma hā pañtsa rakta ba liṃ ta khā hi: zhes mchod/ lnga pa bstod pa ni/ hrīḥbaka' brgyud bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod: yi dam lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod: chos skyong srung ma rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod: nor lha gter bdag rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: zhes pas bstod/ drug pa nongs pa bshags pa ni/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// nyes pa bgyis dang 136)bgyid stsal ba// de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ ces dang yi ge brgyab brjod/ bdun pa rten bzhugs ni/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir// nyid ky-i rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni// ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid bar// de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra swa hā: brgyad pa lhar snang bsdu ba ni/ snang srid ma lus rang gi sku la bsdu: rang nyid thugs ka'i sngags 'khor la thim nas: de yang de dbus hūm̐ dang hrīḥl thim: hūm̐ dang hrīḥyang mi dmigs nam mkha' ltar: zhes stong nyid blo las 'das pa'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag

dgu pa rjes thob zung 'jug gi lha skur ldang ba ni/ hūm̐: rang lus 'byung ba lnga dang skye mched sogs: ye nas rang byung rang gsal yi dam lha: thabs shes dbyer med bskyed rdzogs zung 'brel nas: rgyun du 'gro ba 'dren pa'i spyod lam bya'o: 137) bcu pa bsngo smon ni/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /he ru ka dpal 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog bcu gcig pa bkra shis brjod pa ni/ hūm̐: sku gsum bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog: yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi bkra shis shog: mkha' 'gro chos skyong nor lha'i bkra shis shog: gter srung dam can rgya mtsho'i bkra shis shog: ces sogs rgya cher brjod par bya'o/ gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa la/ zor rdzas bsgrub dang zor sgo dbye// bskul dang 'phang dang bro brdung rjes/ zhes pa ltar drug las/ dang po ni/ sgrub zhag rdzogs pa'i nyin rjes ma la/ zlog pa grub pa'i rjes su/ gtor ma'i lha tshogs rnams la/ badzra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ bstod par 'os pa sa bstod/ yi ge brgya pas bzod gsol dang*/ gtor ma'i ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar btegs/ dam tshig pa bdag la thim par gyur/ 138)slar yang gtor chen zor rdzas dang bcas pa skad cig gi dpal he ru ka dregs pa lha srin sde brgyad kyi dmag tshogs khro gtum 'jigs pa'i gzugs can srid gsum gang ba nad mtshon dug gi char 'bebs pas dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i las la rngams par gyur/ rtsa sngags la zlog sngags btags pa mang du bzla/ thun gtor la dmigs bya dgug bstim bya ba ni/ na mo/ rig 'dzin sogs dang*/ gtor ma bdud rtsir spel zhing 'bul bas/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: a las thod pa'i snod du sogs nas sngags bsngos lan gsum gyis 'bul ba yan gong ltar grub nas/ hūm̐: bcom ldan khro bo'i rgyal po 'khor bcas la: dgra bgegs sha khrag rus pa nang khrol tshogs: lhun por spungs pa'i 'dod rgu'i ba liṃ ta:

phyi nang nyer spyod sman raka bdud rtsi'i tshogs: 'bul lo dgyes par rol la bdag cag gi: nad gdon kun zhi tshe dpal longs spyod spel: khams 139)gsum dbang sdus dgra bgegs bdud sde'i dpung: thams cad ming gi lhag mar tshar chod cig: phas rgol bsam ngan sbyor rtsub byad stems dpung: thams cad rang gshed phob la nus mthu shig: mdor na bdag gi re 'bras gang yod pa: 'bad med lhun gyis grub pa'i phrin las mdzod: ces phul la phyir bzlog gi phrin las gsol lo/ gnyis pa zor sgo dbye ba ni/ zor lam na gnas pa'i dregs pa rnams gser skyems gyi phud kyis mchod cing*/ hūm̐: phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad steng 'og na: gnas pa'i snang srid lha 'dre'i tshogs: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: rig 'dzin bdag gi bka' la nyon: dmar chen drag po'i gtor zor 'di: lha srin tshogs la 'phen snyam ste: dkar po'i phyogs la mi 'phen no: khyed rnams rang rang gnas su gshegs: hūm̐: rnal 'byor zor 140)'phen gang du 'phen: sdang dgra gdon bgegs phyogs su 'phen: phyogs der gnas pa'i gzhi bdag rnams: sku zur dbu smad zhabs sdus la: do nub zor gyi zor lam phyes: 'khor bcas drag po'i dmag sna drongs: sdang dgra gnod bgegs phyogs su khyer: dpa' ba'i 'khrul 'khor der shoms shig: ces rig pa ngar dang ldan pas brjod/ gsum pa bskul ba bya ba ni/ gtor zor sogs stegs las bsgul zhing sgrub khang gi sgo yi nang rol tsam du bkod la/ sman raka bran cing*/ hūm̐: rang bzhin rnam dag chos dbyings drag po'i zhing: sogs gong ltar bskul pa dang*/ hūm̐: sngon tshe slob dpon sogs kyis chad tho sgrog bzhi pa zor bskul zhing 'phang ba ni/ phyar dar dang dkar gtor gser skyems spos kyis sna drangs te gtor zor sogs khyer/ slob dpon 'khor bcas rol mo dang bcas pa'i rting mnan nas song ste gza' rgod drag po rgyu ba'i phyogs sogs gang du 'phen pa'i sar song ste/

gtor 141) zor rnams stegs la bkod/ gser skyems kyis mchod pa dang srid ho'i rgyab yig ni/ gshin rgyud las byung ba/ lha 'dre gang dang gang rgyu ba'i yul lha zo dor sa bdag klu gnyan thams cad nyon cig: khyed rnams la phur pa'i dpal mtshan mi bstan: yungs kar gyi rbab chen mi bsgril: drag po thun gyi pho nya mi 'gyed: drag po mngon spyod kyi las gang byed sar khyed cag rnams ma 'jigs: ma skrag shig: rang gnas su 'dug cig: rig 'dzin rnal 'byor ba bdag gi mgon skyabs dang dpung rogs rgya chen po mdzod cig: ces bklag dgug gzhug sngon du 'gro bas/ hūm̐: nga ni sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos: dpal chen khrag 'thung khro bo'i rgyal: dgra bgegs ma lus bsgral ba'i phyir: de ring drag po'i zor 'phen gyi: bstan pa yongs kyi srung ma dang: sems can phan byed ge la spro: 142) dkar po'i phyogs la dga' ba yi: 'byung po thams cad sku bskyod cig: de ring drag po'i sngags kyi zor: sde brgyad rnams la mi 'phen no: ru nga phrag dog ma mdzad cig: lam la gnas pa gzhan du gshegs: gnas gzhan bskyod par ma nus na: mtho ba rnams kyis zhabs bskum zhig: dma' ba rnams kyi dbu chum zhig: bar pa rnams kyi sku zur zhig: bag med rnams ni bag mdzod cig: zor 'di sdang ba'i dgra la ya: zor 'di gnod pa'i bgegs la ya: drag po'i phrin las ma lus pa: skad cig tsam la sgrub par mdzod: ces bskul zhing 'phang ba la/ kong zor ni/ hūm̐: khrag 'thung khro bo'i rgyal po yis: pho nyar ma ngags pa zor gyi bdag: dgra bgegs sgrol phyir las la ya: gru gsum gdug pa kong bu'i zor: glog ltar 'khyug cing thog ltar 'bebs: dgra bgegs lus 143)sems 'ben la ya: rtsa sngags dang zlog sngags sbrel bas 'phang ngo*/ de bzhin du zor chas gzhan rnams kyang 'phen tshig gong ltar la/ tshig rkang bzhi pa'i tshab tu/ rdo zor la/ ri bo nyil ba rdo yi zor:

zhes dang*/ mda' zor la/ rno myur shugs drag mda' yi zor: zhes dang*/ khrag zor la/ rba klong 'khrugs pa khrag gi zor: zhes dang*/ dug zor la/ mun pa 'thibs pa dug gi zor: zhes dang*/ gtor zor la/ gnam lcags shugs drag gtor ma'i zor: zhes kha bsgyur nas zor bzhi bzhi re 'phang ngo*/ slar dgug gzhug dang*/ gtor chen btegs la/ hūm̐: drag po zor gyi dpung tshogs dgra la bhyo: sogs gong ltar dang zlog sngags dmod tshig dang bcas pas gtor chen zor stabs su sbud pas dgra bo'i rnam shes mar me bsad pa ltar song*/ gnas lus longs spyod thams cad thal bar brlag par bsam zhing thal mo dang rdul mo gdab/ zor rjes gcod ba'i srung 'khor bsgom zhing rdo rje slob dpon gyis 144) rting mnan nas 'ong*/ lnga pa ni/ sgrub khang gi sgo drung du gtor gzhong bshal ba'i phud kyis brtan gtor la phran nas/ hūm̐: slob dpon padma sogs brjod/ gtor gzhong kha sbubs pa'i 'og tu dgra bgegs dgug gzhug bya zhing gtor gzhong ri rab tu gyur pas mnan par bsam la bro brdung ba ni/ hūm̐: stong gsum stong gi sogs dang*/ gtor gzhongakha zed par 'bru 'thor zhing shis pa brjod do/ drug pa rjes chog ni/ nang du log la mchod pa rnams kha gso zhing tshe 'gugs pa ni/ tshe bum de nyid mi dmigs pa las tshe dpag med ji lta bar bskyed cing bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro rnams kyi tshe bcud thams cad bsdus par bsam zhing*/ oṃ badzra a yu dzñā na hūm̐ bhrūm̐: siddhi pha la hūm̐ hrīḥ zhes bzla/ mda' dar g.yab la/ hūm̐: bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med: sku mdog dmar po longs spyod rdzogs: phyag na tshe yi bum pa bsnams: gsang ba thugs kyi bum pa nas: snying po thugs kyi ā yu stsol: bdag cag rdo rje'i 145)tshe thob shog: ces bskul dngos grub blang ba ni/ hrī: 'jigs pa brgyad skyob zhi ba'i dngos grub stsol: 'byor pa drug ldan rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol:

mos pa rnam bzhi dbang gi dngos grub stsol: dgra bgegs tshar gcod drag po'i dngos grub stsol: las bzhi lhun gyis grub pa'i dngos grub stsol: bde stong phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub stsol: mchog dang thun mong gnyis kyi dngos grub stsol: gu ru dhe wa dhā ki ni kā ya wākka tsitta sarba siddhi pha la hoḥ zhes bskul dngos grub kyi phung por gyur pa la rol lo/ btang rag gi mchod bstod dang bzod gsol bya/ ye shes pa brten la bstim zhing dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ bdag nyid 'od gsal du bsdu zhing rjes thob tu lhar ldang*/ dge ba bsngo zhing smon lam 'debs/ shis pa brjod pas mtha' brgyan pa rnams gong ltar bya'o// mkha' 'gro'i snying khrag zab rgu'i 146) skyes// byin rlabs 'dod rgu'i zil mngar can// gnam chos thugs kyi gter kha 'di// nam yang nub med 'phel gyur cig /gter gzhung gser gyi mchod sdong la// zur 'gebs g.yu yi phra tshom spras// 'dis kyang zab gter mchog 'di yi// bstan pa rgyas pa'i btsas gyur cig ces pa'ang rdo rje 'dzin pa gar dbang chags pa'i rdo rje'i bzhed skong du rig pa 'jin pa dpal chen 'dus pas sngon byon grub brnyes 'phags pa'i gsung kho na gung bsdebs pa las rang tshig gtan nas ma 'dres par byin rlabs kyi gzi byin lhag par 'bar ba'i zab chos su spel ba dge legs 'phel// sarba dā ka lya naṃ bha wantu//
